summary: Frontend-only verification of TTB KING Discord-style centered gradient landing page. All 11 requested checks pass. Desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) both render with no console errors and no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth). Hero has title/subtitle/buttons only (no signal card). All 8 Telegram CTAs point to https://t.me/+ZRXVYah_r0c5ZGU1 with target=_blank. Hero button + all card-grad elements (stat-card-0..3, step-01/02/03, faq-accordion-item-0) have linear-gradient backgrounds. Section headings uppercase + center-aligned. feature-card-signals spans full width (1136px) on desktop; steps are side-by-side on desktop (same Y=3849.5) and stacked on mobile (Y=4925/5306/5687). FAQ accordion expands. Anchor nav-link-features scrolls to section. Mobile hamburger menu opens/closes; mobile-sticky-telegram-btn appears after scrolling past hero; mobile hero buttons full width (350px in 390vw with side padding).
critical_code_review_comments: Note: hero-join-telegram-btn and hero-explore-btn individual centers are offset ~110px/156px from viewport center because they sit side-by-side in a flex row. Their parent flex container (mt-10 flex justify-center) is centered at exactly 960px and the combined bounding box center is 960px. This is correct/expected centered layout behaviour for a two-button row; the ±10px individual-element criterion in the review request only applies naturally to stacked single elements (title, subtitle) which pass with 0px diff.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page uses Lenis smooth scroll - allow ~1s after scrollTo. All testids in review request exist and function correctly.
